items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the group in question.
That count is placed among thousands of specified locations.
Those locations are identified as womb-diagrams where beings remain.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the beings tormented is not specified by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places where beings are tormented.
